title: Talk bundle bundle.json, v1
description: One conference's talks, topics, facet names, attribution, vector layout and related talks. The vectors themselves are in the sibling file vectors.i8. Rules a schema cannot state (sort orders, cross-references, hashes, the related lists matching the vectors) are checked by verifyBundle in contracts/js/bundle.mjs and listed in docs/contracts/talk-bundle.md.

attribution.description: What the licence of the schedule content needs to travel with it: the licensor, the licence, the source, the changes made and the publisher's takedown contact.

license.description: For Linux Foundation schedules: CC BY 3.0.

takedown.description: Where to ask for content to be removed: an https URL or a mailto: address.

model.description: The embedding conventions every producer and query-side embedder follows (docs/contracts/talk-bundle.md, Embedding conventions).

onnx.description: The ONNX export the phones and the bundle builder run.

pooling.description: The [CLS] token's last hidden state, not mean pooling. Workers AI is called with pooling: "cls".

normalize.description: Every vector is L2-normalised before it is quantised or compared.

truncation.description: Longer inputs are cut at the end, after tokenisation.

document_instruction.description: Talk text is embedded with no instruction.

document_text.description: How a talk's input string is composed.

query_instruction.description: Prepended to a search query, verbatim from the model card.
query_instruction.const: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

rows.description: talk_id of each row of vectors.i8, in file order: every talk and ambient item, in talks order.

facets.description: The value-matching names: the documents scripts/build-facets.mjs writes to caddie-facets, computed from the kind talk items.

group.description: The tag group for kind tag, else null.

related.description: For every talk with a vector: up to five other talks, most similar first.

NullableHttpUrl.description: An http(s) link or null; the scheme's case is as the feed wrote it. Clients open only http(s) links.

Talk.description: One schedule item, as in data/{slug}/talks.ndjson without session_id, conference, tag_keys, content_hash, ingested_at and speaker_profiles (public bundles carry no speaker bios, photos or links), and with topics.

speaker_taglines.description: Each speaker's one-line tagline from the feed, normally their title and organisation; null when they gave none.

text_hash.description: sha256 of title + "\n" + abstract, UTF-8, hex.
